title: Vermillion Panel: Per-Model & Route Insights
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, horizontally-scrollable insights panel (codename: Vermillion) for Redwood Console that surfaces per-model and per-route performance metrics in a single glance. The panel targets both SREs and product engineers: quick anomaly detection (latency spikes, token regressions), cost attribution rollups, and fast access to rollouts/traffic controls. Focus is on high information density with progressive disclosure so the primary view remains scannable while detailed timelines and token-level traces can be expanded in-place.
acceptance_criteria: Primary panel shows: p50/p95 latency, throughput (req/s), average tokens per request, and cost per 1k tokens for selected route and model
Rows can be toggled between Model-first and Route-first context without losing selected time range
Each metric cell supports drilldown: expand to 6h/24h/7d timeline with anomaly overlays and a top-3 contributing request patterns
Chart spec includes compact microsparkline + mini-violin for latency distribution and a stacked-spark for token composition
Integrated rollouts control allows canary allocation slider and quick rollback CTA; changes link to Dedicated and Private rollout APIs
Design passes a11y color contrast and keyboard focus testing (WCAG AA)
design_decisions: Use compact 48px-high metric tiles with a left microchart and right numeric stack to maximize density
Color palette uses three semantic hues: latency (vermillion), throughput (indigo), cost (amber) — avoids red-only alarm semantics
Latency distribution shown as a small violin beneath the sparkline to communicate variance without full chart expansion
Default time-range is 24h with quick presets (1h, 6h, 24h, 7d) persisted per-user
Interactions favor click-to-expand over hover to work well in keyboard-only and touch contexts
tradeoffs: High-density UI increases cognitive load for new users; mitigated by first-run tooltip overlay and an optional simplified mode
Violin + sparkline consumes more vertical space than a single line, but provides immediate variance signal; decided it's worth the trade for SRE workflows
Embedding rollout controls in the panel introduces operational risk (fast toggles); we require guardrails and API rate limits before enabling for non-admins
accessibility_considerations: All color encodings supplemented with icons/labels for colorblind users
Keyboard focus order matches reading order; expansions are reachable via Enter/Space
Charts include aria-label summaries and numeric tooltips accessible to screen readers
Contrast checks performed on main and alert colors; adjustments made to meet WCAG AA
chart_specs: Latency microchart: sparkline (line) + overlaid anomaly shading; y-axis: ms (log scale optional); p50/p95 markers shown as thin ticks; hover shows exact percentile values
Latency mini-violin: shows kernel density estimate of latencies in selected range; baseline median line; hover states list sample percentiles (p10/p25/p50/p75/p95)
Throughput microchart: area spark with 1-minute aggregation; y-axis: requests per second; stacked color bands indicate model variant buckets (v1/v2/fallback)
Token composition stacked-spark: stacked bar-spark (compact) showing input vs. output tokens ratio over time; hover shows average tokens/request
Cost tile: numeric + trend microspark; secondary line for cost-per-1k-tokens; tooltip includes estimated $ cost for selected range and link to cost breakdown page
Drilldown timeline: full-width chart with request-level swimlane on expand; zoomable; supports exporting top N traces to tracing UI
interactions: Click a metric tile -> expands to inline timeline (animated) with deeper lenses
Keyboard: use Arrow keys to navigate tiles; Enter to expand; Shift+Enter to open detail in new tab
Context menu on tile provides: pin-metric, create-alert, open-in-traces, compare-with (select secondary model/route)
Rollout control: lightweight slider (0-100%) with confirm modal for >20% changes; immediate optimistic UI with background validation and audit log entry
Persisted user filters: selected model, route, region, and time-range stored in user preferences
monitoring_integration: Backend metric names: latency_ms.p50, latency_ms.p95, throughput.req_s, tokens.avg_per_req, cost.usd_per_1k
Alert tie-ins: create alert from tile pre-fills rule with p95 threshold and 5m window
Telemetry: interaction events emitted for expand, rollout-change, and pin-metric to analyze panel usage
compatibility_matrix: Works with model runtime v1.16+ and route schema v3 (adds variant labels)
Falls back to generic metrics if route-level token breakdown not available (shows N/A state with CTA to enable tracing)
Private deployments: panel hides rollout slider if customer disables remote rollouts; shows guidance link
review_feedback: Marco Nguyen (Eng): Ensure the violin rendering cost is low; prefer precomputed histograms from the runtime rather than client-side KDE (action: ENG-19322)
